candidates.name: KS Aganskaya - KS Aleksandrovskaya Gas Pipeline (Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass capacity expansion / looping)
aka: Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya section

evidence.note: Gazprom to build >400 km of gas pipeline by 2029 between KS Aganskaya (KhMAO) and KS Vertikos (Tomsk), raising throughput of Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass; Tomsk has had a transmission-capacity deficit since 2024. Diameter/capacity not stated.
Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya section: laser scanning done, engineering surveys underway; part of the Eastern Gas Supply System, to supply Altai Republic/Krai, Kemerovo, Novosibirsk, Tomsk.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster by name or endpoints. Possible overlap with P2350/P7615 (existing Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass I/II; this would be a new parallel loop of >400 km, length approximate) or P6535/P0734 (Eastern system / Power of Siberia 2 Yamal-Krasnoyarsk legs). Russian end is partly in KhMAO (Urals FD); Tomsk part falls in Siberian FD. Consolidator to decide.
